The documentation follows the objects you compose and the tasks you execute.
Start with one complete example, then read the component guide you need.

## Checks and publication

- [Check a delivery](check-delivery.html): diagnose a rejected attempt and correct it.
- [Quality rules](quality-gates.html): severity, tolerances, references and pointblank.
- [Quality and history](quality-history.html): inspect checks and earlier releases.
- [Publish and correct data](publish-data.html): keep the first accepted delivery.
- [Save a report](save-report.html): retain values and the evidence behind them.

## Composition and case studies

- [Compose products](composing-products.html): checked lookups and shared dependencies.
- [Three deliveries and a report](three-deliveries.html): replace named deliveries independently.
- [Repeat a workflow](everyday-workflows.html): sequential dependencies and selective reruns.
- [Monthly reporting](getting-started.html): complete-month replacement and stock metrics.
- [Cancellation reporting](cancellation-report.html): customer, policy and broker inputs.
- [Relationships and metrics](products-metrics.html): dm relationships and grouped calculations.
- [Insurance reporting](relational-insurance.html): a larger runnable integration example.

## Backends and integrations

- [Integrations](optional-integrations.html): DBI, Parquet, pins, HTTP and targets.
- [Create a DuckLake](create-ducklake.html): configure an explicit DuckLake backend.
- [Shared DuckLake](shared-ducklake.html): PostgreSQL writer coordination.
- [Use dbt](dbt-workflows.html): execute a separately installed dbt CLI.
- [Layered workflows](layered-data-stack.html): receipt checks, raw storage and dbt.
